rows.title: Am I on track — with the numbers in the context
rows.question: Am I on track for my goal?
rows.reply:

rows.title: Should I double the ad budget
rows.question: Should I double my ad budget?
rows.reply:

Also worth flagging: Meta Ads and Google Ads connectors are both off, so no live campaign data is flowing from either right now. The one pending approval you have is the NZ$40/day shift from retargeting to prospecting within your existing budget — that's the move I'd make first before any conversation about more spend.
